note: Create a far-below-market alert — harvest alert_id for update/delete.

response.guide: Confirm the symbol and condition as stored in the response rather than restating the request — the stored threshold or indicator level may be normalized. Surface alert_id so the user can change or remove it later. Alert events are not pushed to the agent: do not promise to watch the market or notify the user, say the alert is set and that they will get their usual Robinhood notification, and offer to check get_alert_log when they next ask. An alert is informational only — not a recommendation to trade, and not a guarantee of execution at that level.
